eps.t: I'm Finally Back From the Fantasy World of Granbahamal After 17 Long Years!
eps.ov: Takafumi’s uncle wakes up from a 17-year coma, claiming he was in another dimension, and he tries to prove it by showing off his magical powers.
Takafumi surprises his uncle with an early birthday present. As the new year begins, Takafumi bumps into a childhood friend.
While Takafumi and his uncle strategize on how to increase their YouTube subscriber count, Fujimiya is worried about the well-being of her crush.

eps.t: You Helped Me Through Tough Times
eps.ov: Fujimiya tries to catch Takafumi’s attention. Takafumi’s uncle shares a seemingly romantic memory he experienced during his time in the other dimension.

eps.t: That Reminds Me, I Almost Got Assassinated Once
eps.ov: Takafumi’s uncle has a flashback to the time he narrowly escaped an assassination attempt — and his story keeps getting grimmer.

eps.t: So They Threw Me Into the Basement of a Freak Show...
eps.ov: Even Takafumi’s uncle has memories he’d rather forget. But he also remembers a rare heroic moment he experienced in the other dimension.

eps.t: As You Can See, Sega Games Are Very Helpful in Life!
eps.ov: Takafumi’s uncle recalls the time he almost made friends in the other dimension. Meanwhile, Fujimiya heads to her college campus to meet someone.

eps.t: I Got Through It by Transforming Into the Most Powerful Being I Know
eps.ov: Takafumi’s uncle continues his story about his search to find the Shining Crusader, revealing a thoughtful side to him — almost like a real hero.

eps.t: The Ice Spirit Demands a Price for Its Cooler Magic
eps.ov: Stuck in an apartment without air conditioning in record breaking heat, Takafumi’s uncle negotiates with the Ice Spirits for help.

eps.t: Civility Only Comes After You're Seen as a Person
eps.ov: Worried that Fujimiya is hanging out with the wrong crowd, her friend from college comes to visit her at Takafumi’s apartment.

eps.t: N-no, I Wasn't Looking at Anything Dirty...
eps.ov: Unable to wield his powers, Takafumi’s uncle finds himself helpless against magic-sealing birds. Later, he has a heart to heart with Alicia.

eps.t: Names Are Important, That's What (He/She) Said
eps.ov: Takafumi’s uncle reminisces about the time he was tasked with hunting down a mysterious singing demon. Meanwhile, he longs to find his way home.

eps.t: It's Thanks to All of You
eps.ov: Up against the legendary venom dragon, Takafumi’s uncle and his cohorts feel hopeless — until Elf comes up with an ingenious plan. Let the battle begin!
